title: Feature Section 116
short_description: A features section organized into two columns on a white background. The left column features a tagline, a heading, descriptive text, and a bottom row of animated logos (infinite scroll). The right column uses a Bento Grids-style layout with two outlined cards. Each card contains a logo at the top, a divider, a list of features with icons, and a dark call-to-action button at the bottom.
